articles.title: ENR FutureTech 2026 Convenes Construction's Top Tech Decision-Makers as Final Few Tickets Remain
articles.description: ENR FutureTech 2026 conference (May 4-6 in San Francisco) brings together top architecture, engineering, and construction firms with technology companies and investors to explore construction technology solutions. Major builders including AECOM Hunt, DPR Construction, Kiewit, and others are attending to evaluate tools for immediate deployment, reflecting a significant industry shift toward adopting construction technology.
articles.sentiment_reasoning: Listed among confirmed technology firms exhibiting at major industry conference with high-caliber attendees

articles.title: 4 Beaten‑Down Software Stocks To Buy After Sector Crash: Goldman Sachs
articles.description: Software stocks have experienced their worst relative selloff on record, with the iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF (IGV) declining 22% over four weeks. Goldman Sachs argues that investor fear around AI disruption has been overdone, creating buying opportunities in four deeply discounted software stocks: MongoDB, Rubrik, Procore, and Nutanix. The bank maintains that platforms owning critical data, orchestration layers, or infrastructure are less likely to be disrupted and more likely to benefit as AI scales.
articles.sentiment_reasoning: Goldman Sachs recommends buying despite 30% YTD decline; construction-volume-linked model and deep integration into governed workflows provide structural leverage against AI agent concerns

articles.title: Procore: Mixed Earnings, Revenue Tops
articles.description: Procore Technologies, a leading provider of cloud-based construction management software, reported strong revenue growth in Q4 2024, surpassing analyst estimates. However, the company faced challenges with profitability, with non-GAAP EPS falling short of expectations. The company is focusing on revenue model enhancement, international expansion, and technology innovation to drive future growth and improve profitability.
articles.sentiment_reasoning: The article presents a mixed outlook for Procore Technologies. While the company exceeded revenue expectations, it faced challenges with profitability, which is a concern. The company is taking strategic initiatives to drive growth and improve profitability, but the overall performance is balanced between positive and negative factors.

articles.title: EarthCam Introduces Project Scheduling for its Jobsite Camera Platform at Procore Groundbreak
articles.description: EarthCam, the leader in live camera technology, has announced new visual data capabilities for Procore, a leading construction industry platform. The integration enables clients to link Procore schedule data directly into EarthCam content, creating dynamic visual reports that merge site imagery with project tasks and milestones.
articles.sentiment_reasoning: The article emphasizes the benefits of the EarthCam-Procore integration, which enables clients to centralize information and access visual content directly within the Procore platform.

articles.title: Estate Planning Tips
articles.description: Dock workers on the East Coast and Gulf of Mexico have stopped work, disrupting over half of U.S. imports and potentially costing $4 billion per day. This strike is an early battle between well-paid workers and advanced automation, which could become a wider trend. Meanwhile, investor sentiment around AI appears to be cooling, with Microsoft facing 'AI fatigue' and SoftBank investing $500 million in OpenAI at a high valuation. The article also covers the basics of estate planning, including wills, beneficiary designations, and trusts.
articles.sentiment_reasoning: Procore is an emerging software company that is embedding AI tools into its construction management software, generating revenue from AI.

articles.title: 3 Tech Stocks to Buy Instead of Nvidia
articles.description: The article discusses three stocks that the author believes are better buys than Nvidia: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSM), Meta Platforms (META), and Procore Technologies (PCOR). The author cites growth potential, valuation, and industry positioning as reasons for their positive sentiment on these stocks.
articles.sentiment_reasoning: The author believes Procore has a long runway for growth in the construction industry, with its software revolutionizing the sector and the potential to become a profitable, massive business.

articles.title: 3 No-Brainer Stocks to Buy Right Now for Less Than $100
articles.description: The article discusses three stocks under $100 per share that the author believes are great buys: PayPal, UiPath, and Procore. PayPal is in the midst of a turnaround, UiPath is in the early stages of a turnaround, and Procore has a massive growth runway in the construction management software market.
articles.sentiment_reasoning: The article highlights Procore's massive growth runway in the construction management software market, strong execution, and a fair stock price, making it an attractive investment.
